title: Pride Villager Level Name
body:
# 🌈 Pride Villager Level Name

Add some colors and diversity to your Minecraft trading! 
**Pride Villager Level Name** is a simple and fun resource pack that replaces the standard boring villager trade levels (Novice, Apprentice, etc.) with pride-themed names. 

### ✨ Changes:
The trading levels have been renamed as follows:
* 🟢 **Level 1** (Novice) ➔ `Heterosexual`
* 🟡 **Level 2** (Apprentice) ➔ `Homosexual`
* 🟠 **Level 3** (Journeyman) ➔ `Bisexual`
* 🟤 **Level 4** (Expert) ➔ `Asexual`
* 🌟 **Level 5** (Master) ➔ `Rainbow Pride`

### 🌍 Supported Languages:
The pack is fully localized and supports the following languages out of the box:
* 🇺🇸 English (`en_us`)
* 🇺🇦 Ukrainian (`uk_ua`)
* 🇷🇺 Russian (`ru_ru`)
* 🇩🇪 German (`de_de`)
* 🇫🇷 French (`fr_fr`)
* 🇪🇸 Spanish (`es_es`, `es_ar`, `es_cl`, `es_mx`)
* 🇨🇳 Chinese (`zh_cn`, `zh_hk`, `zh_tw`)
